emerging_technology: Commercially deployed generative AI for marketing text and imagery; fixed scope across all cases.
intended_application: Proposed use of generative AI for fashion model imagery, audience-specific image variants, captions and concept demand testing before production; no deployment is assumed.
time_horizon: 12 months, an assistant-defined test default, not a reported management deadline.
management_question: What innovation type and business-model disruption exposure does this proposed application create over the stated horizon? Do not decide adoption.
users_stakeholders: Customers, marketing and creative staff, models, photographers, agencies, suppliers and management.
adoption_posture: Moderate/fast-follower, an assistant-defined test assumption, not an assessment of readiness.

evidence_register.title: Oslo Manual 2018, Chapter 2
evidence_register.finding: Paragraphs 2.19-2.20 require implementation and distinguish organizational novelty from novelty to the wider economy.
evidence_register.limit: Does not establish this agent's breakthrough label or disruption thresholds; those are explicit analytical judgments.

evidence_register.title: Hierarchical Text-Conditional Image Generation with CLIP Latents
evidence_register.publisher: Ramesh et al., original research paper
evidence_register.finding: Describes text-conditioned image generation and variations using a two-stage model.
evidence_register.limit: A technical demonstration, not evidence of accurate garment fit, commercial ROI or universal novelty across all generative AI.

evidence_register.title: DALL·E now available without waitlist
evidence_register.finding: Reports public access and a prior beta with pricing, supporting commercial deployment.
evidence_register.limit: Historical commercialization evidence only; not current pricing, vendor comparison or independent performance evidence.

evidence_register.title: H&M continues its exploration of creativity with AI
evidence_register.finding: Reports released digital-twin fashion imagery co-created with a creative team.
evidence_register.limit: Supports a fashion use case and coexistence with human creatives. Does not prove savings, consumer acceptance, workforce displacement or industry-wide adoption.

additional_context: Synthetic classroom scenario. User-supplied premises are assumptions, not verified company facts. All extra operational details are assistant-defined test fixtures. Expected ratings are deliberately excluded from the input. Keep technology and application constant.
capabilities_constraints: No information about revenue model, existing competitive advantage, suppliers, scale or content costs.
